content.short: TransFi enables buying and selling crypto with local currencies through apps, QR codes, and e-wallets.
content.description: TransFi is designed to unlock Web3 access for the next billion users, with a strong emphasis on growing markets across Asia, Latin America, and Africa. Beyond card payments, it supports local currencies through native payment options such as mobile apps, QR code scans, e-wallets, internet banking, and gift cards. A lightweight widget streamlines the checkout flow, letting users complete payments in minutes. Simple sign-up and fast KYC make it easy to swap fiat for crypto and deliver funds to the user’s self-custody wallet of choice.
